messages.content: Please check the actual room choices at Sea Gate and King and Prince for September 12 through 19. It is still one room for two adults. I want the layouts and view wording, exact complete totals, and what is available now.

I checked the current inventory for seven nights. Sea Gate has one King Suite left: 510 square feet, one king bedroom, a separate living area with a sofa, and a kitchenette. The listing describes it as having a furnished balcony with an island or neighborhood view; it does not promise an ocean view. Its complete total is $2,288.44: $1,939.00 room charge, $279.44 taxes, and $70.00 parking.

King and Prince has two relevant king rooms. The Standard King is 325 square feet and faces the parking area; it has no balcony. Its complete total remains $2,496.76. The Partial Ocean View King is also 325 square feet and has a furnished balcony. The hotel describes the view as a side-angle, partial view of the ocean, with buildings or landscaping potentially in the sightline. Its complete total is $2,629.06.
Break down both King and Prince totals. Also, is that a real balcony you can sit on, or one of those narrow standing ledges?

The Standard King is $1,960.00 for the room, $291.76 in taxes, and a $245.00 resort fee, totaling $2,496.76. The Partial Ocean View King is $2,078.00 for the room, $306.06 in taxes, and the same $245.00 resort fee, totaling $2,629.06. Parking is included for both.

The partial-view room has a furnished, walk-out balcony with two chairs and a small table. It is not a standing-only ledge. The room has one king bed and accommodates two adults; there is no separate sitting room.
And the Sea Gate suite balcony does not face the ocean at all?

Correct. The available Sea Gate King Suite does not include an ocean-view guarantee. The room description says island or neighborhood view, and the property confirmed that this unit is on the Ocean Boulevard side. Some water may be visible from an angle, but it is not sold as partial ocean view.
How tight is the inventory at each place? I do not want a vague warning. Tell me what the booking page is showing right now.

Right now, Sea Gate shows one King Suite at $2,288.44 and no other refundable king room for the full week. King and Prince shows two Standard King rooms and one Partial Ocean View King at the quoted refundable rates. Those are live counts displayed by the booking systems, not holds, so they can change until a reservation is completed.
Does the $2,629.06 rate still have the same cancellation deadline we discussed?

Yes. The Partial Ocean View King rate allows free cancellation through September 5, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Eastern. After that, the one-night room charge plus applicable tax is nonrefundable. A one-night deposit of $340.58 is charged when booked, with the remaining balance due at the hotel. No room is currently held.
Compare the practical room space. The Sea Gate one sounds substantially larger.

It is. Sea Gate gives you 185 more square feet, a bedroom separated from the living area, a sofa, and a kitchenette. King and Prince is a conventional single room, so it has less indoor space and no separation between sleeping and seating areas. The tradeoff is access: Sea Gate requires the marked crossing of Ocean Boulevard, while King and Prince connects directly to the beach gate and dune boardwalk. The partial-view King and Prince room costs $340.62 more than the Sea Gate suite and $132.30 more than its own parking-facing room.

The parking-facing room is not worth choosing to save $132.30. Between the Sea Gate suite and the partial-ocean room, I think the direct beach connection and usable balcony settle it. The total is still under $2,650, correct?
Correct. The Partial Ocean View King is $2,629.06 complete, including taxes, the resort fee, and parking. That is $20.94 below the $2,650 limit.
Book the Partial Ocean View King at King and Prince for the fixed dates, one room for my wife and me. Use the refundable rate you just described.

Before I submit it, please confirm the charge due now: a refundable deposit of $340.58 to the payment method on file. The reservation will be for September 12-19, 2026, one Partial Ocean View King for two adults, at a complete total of $2,629.06. Free cancellation ends September 5 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern.

Booked. King and Prince Beach & Golf Resort is confirmed for September 12-19, 2026, for two adults in one Partial Ocean View King at a complete total of $2,629.06. The $340.58 deposit was charged, and the confirmation number is KPB-761284. Free cancellation is available through September 5, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Eastern. Sea Gate was not booked or held.
